description: The Assam government and Google will develop ‘AI Centre of Excellence’ to enhance transparency, efficiency, and citizen services in the State.
body_lead: Assam signs pact with Google to build AI capabilities, to set up centre of excellence The Assam government and Google will develop ‘AI Centre of Excellence’ to enhance transparency, efficiency, and citizen services in the State. Guwahati, Nov 12: The Assam government today signed an understanding with Google under which the tech giant will help the State build Al capabilities.
